description: c/n 4665; a former Canadian Pacific Air Lines Dakota mounted on a rotating pylon outside the museum at the entrance to Whitehorse airport, where it turns into the wind as the world's largest weathervane. A Whitehorse landmark.
Replica of the Queen of the Yukon, the sister ship of Lindbergh's Spirit of St Louis and the first commercial aircraft in the Yukon. Finished in silver.
aliases: B1; B-1; Brougham; Queen of the Yukon
